name: Everyday Web Scraper & Report Generator
description: Practical everyday automated data pipeline that fetches web data, parses structured items, and exports a responsive HTML and Markdown summary report.
acceptance_criteria: Fetcher module handles HTTP requests with retry logic and error logging
Parser extracts article titles, URLs, and summaries into clean dictionaries
Reporter generates an HTML report with clean styling and a Markdown summary table

slices.title: HTTP Data Fetcher
slices.description: Implement fetch_page with retry count and headers.

signatures.fetch_content: def fetch_content(url: str, retries: int = 2) -> dict

invariants: Returns dict with status_code, content, and url

acceptance_tests.tests/test_fetcher.py:
from scraper.fetcher import fetch_content

def test_fetch():
    res = fetch_content('https://example.com')
    assert 'status_code' in res
    assert 'content' in res

slices.title: HTML Item Parser
slices.description: Extract structured articles/records from HTML text.

invariants: Returns list of item dicts with title and link keys

acceptance_tests.tests/test_parser.py:
from scraper.parser import parse_items def test_parser(): html = '

Headline 1

Summary 1

' items = parse_items(html) assert len(items) == 1 assert items[0]['title'] == 'Headline 1' assert items[0]['link'] == '/post1'

slices.title: Report Generator (Markdown & HTML)
slices.description: Format parsed items into an HTML digest report and Markdown summary.

invariants: Returns dict with html and markdown keys

acceptance_tests.tests/test_reporter.py:
from scraper.reporter import generate_report

def test_report():
    items = [{'title': 'Item A', 'link': 'https://a.com', 'summary': 'Detail A'}]
    rep = generate_report(items)
    assert '<table>' in rep['html']
    assert '| Item A |' in rep['markdown']
